name: Hermes Graph
description: Obsidian-style graph of the workspace files plus the Hermes brain — memory, skills, sessions, crons and MCP servers — indexed read-only by a loopback sidecar, with a collision-free force layout and WebGL rendering.
author: gleison

post_install.summary: Install sidecar/hermes-graph-sidecar.service as a systemd user unit (127.0.0.1:17803), then approve the sidecar proxy in Settings → Extensions → Diagnostics. WebUI authentication must be enabled for the token-v1 proxy to work.

filesystem.note: The browser assets read no files. The sidecar reads (read-only, never following symlinks) the configured workspace roots, ~/.hermes/skills, ~/.hermes/memories, ~/.hermes/webui/sessions, ~/.hermes/cron/jobs.json and the mcp_servers key names of ~/.hermes/config.yaml. Files whose names look sensitive (creds, tokens, keys, .env) are never opened. It writes one SQLite cache under <state dir>/hermes-graph/.
